Message.Name: Timestamp Message
Message.Description: This message is sent to provide the time since Epoch. It should be used in combination with the Timestamp field of individual messages to determine the exact time for each message.

Field.Name: Nanosecond
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since Epoch.

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: This message will be sent to provide information about events that are scheduled or triggered by the system. Events may occur at Orderbook, Board, Board+Product or System level.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: Group
Field.Description: Identifies the Board for which this event applies. Left blank if not at Board level.

Field.Name: Product
Field.Description: Identifies the Product for which this event applies. Left blank if not at Product level.

Field.Name: Orderbook
Field.Description: Identifies the Orderbook for which this event applies. Set to 0 if not at Orderbook level.

Field.Name: EventCode
Field.Description: Text identifier for the event.

Field.Name: EventStatus
Field.Description: Current status of the event.

Field.Name: ScheduledTime
Field.Description: Event trigger time in nanoseconds since Epoch (UTC).

Message.Name: Price Tick Size Message
Message.Description: This message provides the price ticks (steps) for the orderbooks in the system. It should be used as a lookup from Orderbook Directory [R] messages.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: TickSizeTableId
Field.Description: Price Tick Size Table identifier, to be looked up from Orderbook Directory [R] messages.

Field.Name: TickSize
Field.Description: The incremental price step value.

Field.Name: PriceStart
Field.Description: Starting Price for this Tick Size.

Message.Name: Quantity Tick Size Message
Message.Description: This message provides the quantity ticks (steps) for the orderbooks in the system. It should be used as a lookup from Orderbook Directory [R] messages.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: TickSizeTableId
Field.Description: Quantity Tick Size Table identifier, to be looked up from Orderbook Directory [R] messages.

Field.Name: TickSize
Field.Description: Quantity Tick Size value.

Field.Name: QuantityStart
Field.Description: Starting Quantity for this Tick Size.

Message.Name: Orderbook Directory Message
Message.Description: Orderbook Directory Messages are transmitted during the reference data spin. Static data messages are sent at the beginning of the feed and contain exchange reference information.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: Orderbook
Field.Description: Unique orderbook identifier.

Field.Name: ISIN
Field.Description: ISIN Code. Left blank if not applicable.

Field.Name: SecurityCode
Field.Description: Unique text identifier for the security.

Field.Name: SecurityName
Field.Description: Descriptive name for the security.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Trading currency.

Field.Name: Board
Field.Description: Identifies the Board this orderbook trades on.

Field.Name: Product
Field.Description: Product the security is derived from.

Field.Name: MinimumQuantity
Field.Description: Minimum order quantity. Maximum value indicates non-tradeable.

Field.Name: QuantityTickSizeTableId
Field.Description: Cross-reference to Quantity Tick Size [M] messages.

Field.Name: QuantityDecimals
Field.Description: Decimals for quantity field decoding. Quantity = Integer / 10^QuantityDecimals.

Field.Name: PriceTickSizeTableId
Field.Description: Cross-reference to Price Tick Size [L] messages.

Field.Name: PriceDecimals
Field.Description: Decimals for price field decoding. Price = Integer / 10^PriceDecimals.

Field.Name: Listing
Field.Description: Listing date/time in YYYYMMDDHHMMSS format. Zero indicates none.

Field.Name: Expiry
Field.Description: Expiry/delist date/time in YYYYMMDDHHMMSS format. Zero indicates none.

Field.Name: AssetType
Field.Description: Asset type code. Blank if not applicable.

Field.Name: SettleDate
Field.Description: Settlement date in YYYYMMDD format.

Field.Name: Reference
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Remarks
Field.Description: Security board remarks for conditional markets.

Message.Name: Orderbook Trading Action Message
Message.Description: This message indicates the current trading state of an orderbook.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: Orderbook
Field.Description: Unique orderbook identifier.

Field.Name: TradingState
Field.Description: Current trading state code for orderbook.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Trading state reason. Blank if not applicable.

Message.Name: Orderbook Attribute Message
Message.Description: This message provides dynamic reference values for an orderbook.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: Orderbook
Field.Description: Unique orderbook identifier.

Field.Name: AttributeValue
Field.Description: The value that has been set, according to the AttributeType. Decode using the Price Decimals for the orderbook, unless otherwise specified.

Field.Name: AttributeType
Field.Description: Identifies the attribute type being referenced.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Not used - Reserved for future use.

Message.Name: Firm Directory Message
Message.Description: This message provides reference information about system participants.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: FirmID
Field.Description: Unique firm identifier.

Field.Name: FirmCode
Field.Description: The firm's text identifier.

Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: This message is sent when an order is added to the orderbook.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: OrderNumber
Field.Description: The day unique reference number assigned to the new order.

Field.Name: OrderVerb
Field.Description: Buy/Sell indicator.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The total quantity of the order being added to the book.

Field.Name: Orderbook
Field.Description: The unique orderbook identifier.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price of the new order.

Field.Name: FirmID
Field.Description: The unique firm identifier for the order. Value of 0 indicates no applicable firm.

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: This message is sent when an order on the book is executed in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: OrderNumber
Field.Description: The order reference number of the executed order.

Field.Name: ExecutedQuantity
Field.Description: The quantity executed.

Field.Name: MatchNumber
Field.Description: The day unique match identifier.

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if execution reflects in volume calculations.

Field.Name: Aggressor Firm ID
Field.Description: The unique firm identifier for the aggressor order. Value of 0 indicates no applicable firm.

Message.Name: Order Executed with Price Message
Message.Description: This message is sent when an order on the book is executed in whole or in part at a negotiated price different from the order price.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: OrderNumber
Field.Description: The order reference number of the executed order.

Field.Name: ExecutedQuantity
Field.Description: The quantity executed.

Field.Name: MatchNumber
Field.Description: The day unique match identifier.

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates execution reflection in volume calculations.

Field.Name: ExecutionPrice
Field.Description: The price at which the execution occurred.

Message.Name: Broken Trade Message
Message.Description: This message is sent when a trade is cancelled.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: MatchNumber
Field.Description: The unique match number of the execution that was busted.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Reason code for trade cancellation.

Message.Name: Order Delete Message
Message.Description: This message indicates when an order has been removed from the orderbook.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: OrderNumber
Field.Description: The order reference number of the order being removed.

Message.Name: Order Replace Message
Message.Description: This message indicates when an order in the orderbook has been modified.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: OriginalOrderNumber
Field.Description: The original order number of the order being replaced.

Field.Name: NewOrderNumber
Field.Description: The new reference number for the order following its replacement.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The new total quantity.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The new price for the order.

Message.Name: Indicative Price/Quantity Message
Message.Description: This message provides auction information including the theoretical opening price and quantity.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: TheoreticalOpeningQuantity
Field.Description: Total quantity eligible for matching at current theoretical opening price.

Field.Name: Orderbook
Field.Description: Unique orderbook identifier.

Field.Name: BestBid
Field.Description: Current best buy price.

Field.Name: BestOffer
Field.Description: Current best sell price.

Field.Name: TheoreticalOpeningPrice
Field.Description: Theoretical price eligible for matching upon auction uncross.

Field.Name: CrossType
Field.Description: Auction type identifier. Blank if not applicable.

Field.Name: BestBidSize
Field.Description: Aggregated quantity at best bid price.

Field.Name: BestOfferSize
Field.Description: Aggregated quantity available at best offer price.

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: This message is sent to provide information about off-book matching.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: ExecutedQuantity
Field.Description: The quantity executed.

Field.Name: Orderbook
Field.Description: Unique orderbook identifier.

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Trade publication indicator.

Field.Name: ExecutionPrice
Field.Description: The price at which execution occurred.

Field.Name: MatchNumber
Field.Description: The unique match identifier.

Field.Name: TradeIndicator
Field.Description: Trade type. Blank for regular trade.

Field.Name: BuyFirmID
Field.Description: Firm ID of buy-side counterparty.

Field.Name: SellFirmID
Field.Description: Firm ID of sell-side counterparty.

Field.Name: Trade Source
Field.Description: NSX source code (A-Z). Supplied only when TradeIndicator = B.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: Orderbook
Field.Description: Unique orderbook identifier. 0 indicates no orderbook is associated.

Field.Name: NewsId
Field.Description: Unique news item identifier.

Field.Name: FirmCode
Field.Description: Firm code. Left blank if no firm is associated with this news.

Field.Name: Title
Field.Description: News Title. Null-terminated string, maximum 81 characters.

Field.Name: Reference
Field.Description: Reference text for the news item (e.g. a URL, file pathname). Null-terminated string, maximum 256 characters.

Field.Name: NewsText
Field.Description: News data. Null-terminated string, maximum 512 characters.

Message.Name: Index Member Directory Message
Message.Description: This message provides details about index members and their respective weightings within an index.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: IndexOrderbook
Field.Description: Unique orderbook identifier for the index.

Field.Name: MemberOrderbook
Field.Description: Unique orderbook identifier for the index member.

Field.Name: Weight
Field.Description: Index member's weighting as part of the index.

Message.Name: Index Value Message
Message.Description: This message disseminates index values to market participants.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since last ITCH Timestamp "T" message.

Field.Name: IndexOrderbook
Field.Description: Unique orderbook identifier for the index.

Field.Name: IndexValue
Field.Description: Value for the index, using the price decimals for the orderbook.
